necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Cardiac event monitoring is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes. This clinical justification supports the medical necessity of CPT 93271 despite the denial based on reason code PR-204.
